root_cause: When app.js was not fully initialized, the trip form had no submit listener. The browser therefore performed a normal HTML form submission, reloading index.html and returning to the default dashboard. The critical Start-button fallback made this failure reachable because it could open the planner even while the main app module was not ready.
fix: critical-ui.js now owns the trip form submit event in capture phase and always prevents native form navigation.
The real search workflow was extracted to a top-level submitTripForm() and exposed as window.reisslimSubmitTrip before initialize() runs.
On a cold load the critical submit bridge waits up to two seconds for the app module to register, then invokes the full search exactly once.
If the main module never becomes available, the app stays on the planner and shows an explicit loading error instead of returning to the dashboard.
